svg.title: Dapur360 design board: four roles and their use cases on the left, the core data model linking tables, orders, menu recipes, ingredients and stock on the right, and the order status flow.
svg.text: QR self-ordering, cashier, kitchen queue, purchasing and ingredient stock in one design
Ordered by table, so customers never need an account
Each sale draws ingredients through the recipe; stock out is taken from a specific stock-in batch.
Simplified from the class diagram and use case diagram
